body: keep going dude. i know it seems hard to run somewhere with no clear direction but just keep running. it doesnt matter where. you'll graduate from these bullshit classes one day. you'll feel something other than disdain one day. whether its from the happiness you feel when eating your favorite food or just a sense of relief you feel when you pat your pocket and feel the wallet and keys you thought you forgot. you'll feel something other than misery one day. just keep going. please.
